source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Being essentially identical to typical, everyday tiredness and resolving easily after just a single night of rest","B":"Occurring only during active chemotherapy treatment itself, never persisting once the treatment course has ended","C":"Having fairly little established assessment or management approach despite being a well-recognized clinical concern in oncology","D":"Is often more severe, persistent, and disproportionate to activity level compared to typical fatigue, significantly impacting quality of life"}}
source_row.rationale: Cancer-related fatigue is often more severe, persistent, and disproportionate to activity level compared to typical fatigue, significantly impacting quality of life, and can persist even after treatment completion, requiring dedicated assessment and multifaceted management approaches.
source_row.source_name: ONS — Cancer-Related Fatigue Assessment and Management
